1	/-

     5	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRankOneOpen
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneNativePresentation
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Assembly from a represented evaluation-divisor fibre
    10	
    11	This file isolates the last presheaf step in the arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre construction.
    12	Its input ties an open `W` to the displayed family, supplies native presentations on every
    13	affine pullback, and supplies the canonical evaluation-divisor classifier.  The geometric input
    14	to the assembly theorem is the genuine pullback square of that evaluation divisor along Abel.
    15	The universal property of this stronger square produces, rather than assumes, the factorisation
    16	field of `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`.
    17	
    18	The global construction of the canonical classifier and its represented pullbacks remains an
    19	upstream obligation.  The endpoint here keeps that obligation in its geometric `IsPullback`
    20	form and feeds the resulting arbitrary-scheme fibres immediately to
    21	`picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented`.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    30	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    35	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    36	
    37	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    38	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    39	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    40	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    41	
    42	noncomputable section
    43	
    44	abbrev rankOneAmbient : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    45	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    46	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))
    47	
    48	abbrev rankOneLocus : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    49	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
    50	
    51	abbrev genusDivisorYoneda : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    52	  yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left
    53	
    54	/-! ## The explicit geometric input -/
    55	
    56	/--
    57	The explicit data needed to assemble one arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre.
    58	
    59	`restrictedValue` is the restriction of the displayed ambient family to `W`, and
    60	`nativePresentation` quantifies over every affine pullback of that value.  The map
    61	`canonicalEvaluationDivisor` is the evaluation-divisor classifier on the rank-one locus, with
    62	its Abel compatibility kept explicit.  Divisor representability is deliberately not a field of
    63	this structure: it is supplied separately as a pullback square to the assembly theorem.
    64	
    65	In particular, no field-fibre dimension witness, unrelated line bundle, or pre-existing
    66	`PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` is accepted by this contract.  Conversely, this structure is not
    67	itself a producer: an inhabitant must still supply the arbitrary-affine native presentations and
    68	the canonical divisor classifier.
    69	-/
    70	structure PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
    71	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
    72	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)) where
    73	  W : X.Opens
    74	  restrictedValue : rankOneAmbient (C := C).obj (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
    75	  restrictedValue_eq :
    76	    restrictedValue =
    77	      (yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g).app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) (𝟙 (W : Scheme.{u}))
    78	  /-- The tied native presentation on every affine pullback of the restricted family value. -/
    79	  nativePresentation :
    80	    ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    81	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ Over.mk restrictedValue.1),
    82	      Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
    83	        ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op restrictedValue.2))
    84	  /-- The canonical evaluation divisor classifier on the public rank-one locus. -/
    85	  canonicalEvaluationDivisor :
    86	    rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶ genusDivisorYoneda (C := C)
    87	  canonicalEvaluationDivisor_abel :
    88	    canonicalEvaluationDivisor ≫ abelDivAffGenusSigma C =
    89	      picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi
    90	
    91	namespace PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
    92	
    93	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
    94	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)}
    95	
    96	/-- The Sigma-extended public-locus inclusion is injective on every test scheme. -/
    97	lemma picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl_app_injective (S : Scheme.{u}) :
    98	    Function.Injective ((picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S)) := by
    99	  rintro ⟨a, x⟩ ⟨b, y⟩ h
   100	  dsimp [picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   101	    CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat] at h
   102	  have hab : a = b := congrArg Sigma.fst h
   103	  subst b
   104	  congr 1
   105	  apply Subtype.ext
   106	  exact eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj h).2
   107	
   108	/-- The public-locus element carried by the restricted family value over `W`. -/
   109	noncomputable def locusValue (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi g) :
   110	    rankOneLocus.obj (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) :=
   111	  ⟨F.restrictedValue.1, ⟨F.restrictedValue.2,
   112	    mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations pi
   113	      (fun A _ _ t => F.nativePresentation A t)⟩⟩
   114	
   115	/-- The map into the public locus is obtained from its universal element by Yoneda. -/
   116	noncomputable def fst (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi g) :
   117	    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
   118	  yonedaEquiv.symm F.locusValue
   119	
   120	/-- The canonical evaluation divisor of the restricted family value over `W`. -/
   121	noncomputable def evaluationDivisor
   122	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi g) :
   123	    (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left :=
   124	  F.canonicalEvaluationDivisor.app (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) F.locusValue
   125	
   126	/-- The factorisation clause required by `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`, exposed as the target
   127	of the represented evaluation-divisor argument below. -/
   128	def FibreFactorizationClause
   129	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi g) : Prop :=
   130	  ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : rankOneLocus.obj (op S)) (w : S ⟶ X),
   131	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v =
   132	      g.app (op S) w →
   133	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (F.W : Scheme.{u}),
   134	      F.fst.app (op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ F.W.ι = w
   135	
   136	lemma fst_comp_incl (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi g) :
   137	    F.fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
   138	  apply yonedaEquiv.injective
   139	  change (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) F.locusValue =
   140	    (yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g).app (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) (𝟙 (F.W : Scheme.{u}))
   141	  dsimp [locusValue, picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   142	    CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat]
   143	  rw [← F.restrictedValue_eq]
   144	
   145	lemma canonicalEvaluationDivisor_abel_app
   146	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi g)
   147	    (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : rankOneLocus.obj (op S)) :
   148	    (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op S)
   149	        (F.canonicalEvaluationDivisor.app (op S) v) =
   150	      (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v := by
   151	  have h := congrArg
   152	    (fun q => q.app (op S) v) F.canonicalEvaluationDivisor_abel
   153	  exact h
   154	
   155	/-- The family evaluation divisor has the displayed family as its Abel class. -/
   156	lemma evaluationDivisor_abel
   157	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi g) :
   158	    yoneda.map F.evaluationDivisor ≫ abelDivAffGenusSigma C =
   159	      yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
   160	  have heval :
   161	      yoneda.map F.evaluationDivisor =
   162	        F.fst ≫ F.canonicalEvaluationDivisor := by
   163	    apply yonedaEquiv.injective
   164	    rw [yonedaEquiv_yoneda_map]
   165	    rw [yonedaEquiv_comp]
   166	    have hx := yonedaEquiv_comp
   167	      (yonedaEquiv.symm F.locusValue) F.canonicalEvaluationDivisor
   168	    rw [hx]
   169	    simp [fst]
   170	  rw [heval, Category.assoc, F.canonicalEvaluationDivisor_abel]
   171	  exact F.fst_comp_incl
   172	
   173	/-! ## The represented evaluation-divisor square -/
   174	
   175	/-- The canonical evaluation divisor represents the pullback of Abel along the displayed
   176	family.  This is stronger than the factorisation clause for the public rank-one locus: it is a
   177	categorical pullback against the entire represented genus-divisor functor. -/
   178	def EvaluationDivisorPullback
   179	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi g) : Prop :=
   180	  IsPullback
   181	    (yoneda.map F.evaluationDivisor)
   182	    (yoneda.map F.W.ι)
   183	    (abelDivAffGenusSigma C)
   184	    g
   185	
   186	/-- The represented evaluation-divisor square produces the public-locus factorisation on every
   187	test scheme. -/
   188	lemma fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
   189	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi g)
   190	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   191	    F.FibreFactorizationClause := by
   192	  intro S v w hvw

import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafExtraction
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocusNative

/-!
# The canonical native rank-one presentation contract

`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` deliberately leaves the geometric producer fields explicit.
This file fixes the module part of that contract: for a tied cocycle datum `D`, the module is
always `D.nativeModule` and its base-ring comparison is always
`D.nativeModuleKSheafIso`.  The native piece trivializations supply the line-bundle field;
arbitrary-cartesian pushforward base change and the cohomology/rank certificates stay as
explicit obligations.

The resulting contract is therefore an adapter interface for a future producer, rather than a
second choice of a line bundle.  Its conversion is consumed directly by the public
`PicRankOneOpen` membership theorem below; no unrelated module or untied class can enter
through this bridge, and the adapter itself does not provide the geometric certificates.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
  CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
-/
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepAffChallenge
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AtlasFromDivRep

/-!
# Category-correct ambient contract for the rank-one Picard route

The rank-one locus lives in degree `genus C`, not in `pic0`. This module installs the concrete
ambient maps that the later open-locus restriction must consume:

* `abelDivAffTrans` maps the widened degree-`n` divisor functor to `picDegLayerFunctor C n`;
* `abelDivAffSigma` extends a represented slice map to the ambient big-site presheaf;
* `abelDivAffGenusSigma` specializes the map using the canonical genus representation.

The future public `PicRankOneOpen` must therefore be a subfunctor of
`picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C)`, and `DivRankOneOpen` must be an open of
`divRepAffGenusScheme C`. Its `rankOneAbel` is the restriction of
`abelDivAffGenusSigma`, after applying the corresponding Sigma extension. No placeholder locus,
inverse, representability witness, or endgame theorem is postulated here.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} {n : ℕ}

/-
Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
-/
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocus
import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Restrict

/-!
# The universal divisor rank-one open contract

The genus divisor representer is unconditional, while the rank-one restriction still needs a
family-level open-locus producer.  This file separates those two facts.  The predicate below is
the inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` along the represented universal Abel map.  A
`DivRankOneOpenData` witness identifies that predicate with the range of one actual open of the
representer; only after that witness is supplied do we define the open subscheme.

This shape prevents a logical `Subfunctor` from being silently reinterpreted as a scheme.  It also
gives the canonical inverse lane a stable contract: it consumes the witness equality and can use
the resulting open inclusion and all of its pullbacks without choosing a generator.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]

events.text: One interface issue remains in the draft: the classifier is currently stored separately for each `X,g`, so “canonical” has no cross-family coherence. I’m tightening the same file once more by extracting one global evaluation-divisor datum and parameterizing every arbitrary-scheme fibre by it; the pullback proof will then use the same classifier for all tests.

45	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    46	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))
    47	
    48	abbrev rankOneLocus : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    49	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
    50	
    51	abbrev genusDivisorYoneda : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    52	  yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left
    53	
    54	/-! ## The explicit geometric input -/
    55	
    56	/-- The single canonical evaluation-divisor classifier used by every represented fibre.
    57	
    58	Keeping this datum outside `PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput` prevents the classifier from
    59	varying with the test scheme or displayed family. -/
    60	structure PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData where
    61	  divisor : rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶ genusDivisorYoneda (C := C)
    62	  abel : divisor ≫ abelDivAffGenusSigma C = picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi
    63	
    64	/--
    65	The explicit data needed to assemble one arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre.
    66	
    67	`restrictedValue` is the restriction of the displayed ambient family to `W`, and
    68	`nativePresentation` quantifies over every affine pullback of that value.  The map
    69	`canonicalEvaluationDivisor` is the evaluation-divisor classifier on the rank-one locus, with
    70	its Abel compatibility kept explicit.  Divisor representability is deliberately not a field of
    71	this structure: it is supplied separately as a pullback square to the assembly theorem.
    72	
    73	In particular, no field-fibre dimension witness, unrelated line bundle, or pre-existing
    74	`PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` is accepted by this contract.  Conversely, this structure is not
    75	itself a producer: an inhabitant must still supply the arbitrary-affine native presentations and
    76	the canonical divisor classifier.
    77	-/
    78	structure PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
    79	    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
    80	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
    81	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)) where
    82	  W : X.Opens
    83	  restrictedValue : rankOneAmbient (C := C).obj (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
    84	  restrictedValue_eq :
    85	    restrictedValue =
    86	      (yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g).app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) (𝟙 (W : Scheme.{u}))
    87	  /-- The tied native presentation on every affine pullback of the restricted family value. -/
    88	  nativePresentation :
    89	    ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    90	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ Over.mk restrictedValue.1),
    91	      Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
    92	        ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op restrictedValue.2))
    93	
    94	namespace PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
    95	
    96	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
    97	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)}
    98	variable {E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi}
    99	
   100	/-- The Sigma-extended public-locus inclusion is injective on every test scheme. -/
   101	lemma picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl_app_injective (S : Scheme.{u}) :
   102	    Function.Injective ((picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S)) := by
   103	  rintro ⟨a, x⟩ ⟨b, y⟩ h
   104	  dsimp [picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   105	    CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat] at h
   106	  have hab : a = b := congrArg Sigma.fst h
   107	  subst b
   108	  congr 1
   109	  apply Subtype.ext
   110	  exact eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj h).2
   111	
   112	/-- The public-locus element carried by the restricted family value over `W`. -/
   113	noncomputable def locusValue (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   114	    rankOneLocus.obj (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) :=
   115	  ⟨F.restrictedValue.1, ⟨F.restrictedValue.2,
   116	    mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations pi
   117	      (fun A _ _ t => F.nativePresentation A t)⟩⟩
   118	
   119	/-- The map into the public locus is obtained from its universal element by Yoneda. -/
   120	noncomputable def fst (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   121	    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
   122	  yonedaEquiv.symm F.locusValue
   123	
   124	/-- The canonical evaluation divisor of the restricted family value over `W`. -/
   125	noncomputable def evaluationDivisor
   126	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   127	    (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left :=
   128	  E.divisor.app (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) F.locusValue
   129	
   130	/-- The factorisation clause required by `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`, exposed as the target
   131	of the represented evaluation-divisor argument below. -/
   132	def FibreFactorizationClause
   133	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
   134	  ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : rankOneLocus.obj (op S)) (w : S ⟶ X),
   135	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v =
   136	      g.app (op S) w →
   137	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (F.W : Scheme.{u}),
   138	      F.fst.app (op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ F.W.ι = w
   139	
   140	lemma fst_comp_incl (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   141	    F.fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
   142	  apply yonedaEquiv.injective
   143	  change (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) F.locusValue =
   144	    (yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g).app (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) (𝟙 (F.W : Scheme.{u}))
   145	  dsimp [locusValue, picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   146	    CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat]
   147	  rw [← F.restrictedValue_eq]
   148	
   149	lemma canonicalEvaluationDivisor_abel_app
   150	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   151	    (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : rankOneLocus.obj (op S)) :
   152	    (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op S)
   153	        (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
   154	      (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v := by
   155	  have h := congrArg
   156	    (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.abel
   157	  exact h
   158	
   159	/-- The family evaluation divisor has the displayed family as its Abel class. -/
   160	lemma evaluationDivisor_abel
   161	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   162	    yoneda.map F.evaluationDivisor ≫ abelDivAffGenusSigma C =
   163	      yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
   164	  have heval :
   165	      yoneda.map F.evaluationDivisor =
   166	        F.fst ≫ E.divisor := by
   167	    apply yonedaEquiv.injective
   168	    rw [yonedaEquiv_yoneda_map]
   169	    rw [yonedaEquiv_comp]
   170	    have hx := yonedaEquiv_comp
   171	      (yonedaEquiv.symm F.locusValue) E.divisor
   172	    rw [hx]
   173	    simp [fst]
   174	  rw [heval, Category.assoc, E.abel]
   175	  exact F.fst_comp_incl
   176	
   177	/-! ## The represented evaluation-divisor square -/
   178	
   179	/-- The canonical evaluation divisor represents the pullback of Abel along the displayed
   180	family.  This is stronger than the factorisation clause for the public rank-one locus: it is a
   181	categorical pullback against the entire represented genus-divisor functor. -/
   182	def EvaluationDivisorPullback
   183	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
   184	  IsPullback
   185	    (yoneda.map F.evaluationDivisor)
   186	    (yoneda.map F.W.ι)
   187	    (abelDivAffGenusSigma C)
   188	    g
   189	
   190	/-- The represented evaluation-divisor square produces the public-locus factorisation on every
   191	test scheme. -/
   192	lemma fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
   193	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   194	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   195	    F.FibreFactorizationClause := by
   196	  intro S v w hvw
   197	  have hS := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op S)
   198	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hS
   199	  have hcompat :
   200	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op S)
   201	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
   202	        g.app (op S) w := by
   203	    rw [F.canonicalEvaluationDivisor_abel_app S v]
   204	    exact hvw
   205	  obtain ⟨u, _huDivisor, huW⟩ :=
   206	    hS.2.2 (E.divisor.app (op S) v) w hcompat
   207	  change u ≫ F.W.ι = w at huW
   208	  refine ⟨u, ?_, huW⟩
   209	  apply picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl_app_injective pi S
   210	  have hsquare := congrArg
   211	    (fun q => q.app (op S) u) F.fst_comp_incl
   212	  change
   213	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u) =
   214	      g.app (op S) (u ≫ F.W.ι) at hsquare
   215	  calc
   216	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u) =
   217	        g.app (op S) (u ≫ F.W.ι) := hsquare
   218	    _ = g.app (op S) w := congrArg _ huW
   219	    _ = (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v := hvw.symm
   220	
   221	/-! ## Assembly of the stronger fibre datum -/
   222	
   223	/-- Assemble the public fibre presentation from the represented canonical evaluation-divisor
   224	square.  Its `exists_factor` field is derived from the pullback universal property. -/
   225	noncomputable def toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
   226	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   227	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   228	    PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g where
   229	  W := F.W
   230	  fst := F.fst
   231	  sq := F.fst_comp_incl
   232	  exists_factor := by
   233	    simpa only [FibreFactorizationClause] using
   234	      F.fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback hpb
   235	
   236	@[simp]
   237	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_W
   238	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   239	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   240	    (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback hpb).W = F.W :=
   241	  rfl
   242	
   243	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_isPullback
   244	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   245	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   246	    IsPullback F.fst (yoneda.map F.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g :=
   247	  (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback hpb).isPullback
   248	
   249	/-! ## Immediate openness consumer -/
   250	
   251	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_evaluationDivisorPullbackFamilies
   252	    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
   253	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   254	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
   255	      PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   256	    (hpb : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   257	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
   258	      (D X g).EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   259	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
   260	  apply picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented pi
   261	  intro X g
   262	  exact (D X g).toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback (hpb X g)
   263	
   264	end PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
   265	
   266	end
   267	end AlgebraicGeometry

   121	        ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op restrictedValue.2))
   122	
   123	namespace PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
   124	
   125	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
   126	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)}
   127	variable {E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi}
   128	
   129	/-- The Sigma-extended public-locus inclusion is injective on every test scheme. -/
   130	lemma picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl_app_injective (S : Scheme.{u}) :
   131	    Function.Injective ((picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S)) := by
   132	  rintro ⟨a, x⟩ ⟨b, y⟩ h
   133	  dsimp [picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   134	    CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat] at h
   135	  have hab : a = b := congrArg Sigma.fst h
   136	  subst b
   137	  congr 1
   138	  apply Subtype.ext
   139	  exact eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj h).2
   140	
   141	/-- The public-locus element carried by the restricted family value over `W`. -/
   142	noncomputable def locusValue (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   143	    rankOneLocus.obj (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) :=
   144	  ⟨F.restrictedValue.1, ⟨F.restrictedValue.2,
   145	    mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations pi
   146	      (fun A _ _ t => F.nativePresentation A t)⟩⟩
   147	
   148	/-- The map into the public locus is obtained from its universal element by Yoneda. -/
   149	noncomputable def fst (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   150	    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
   151	  yonedaEquiv.symm F.locusValue
   152	
   153	/-- The canonical evaluation divisor of the restricted family value over `W`. -/
   154	noncomputable def evaluationDivisor
   155	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   156	    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
   157	  F.fst ≫ E.divisor
   158	
   159	/-- The factorisation clause required by `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`, exposed as the target
   160	of the represented evaluation-divisor argument below. -/
   161	def FibreFactorizationClause
   162	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
   163	  ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : rankOneLocus.obj (op S)) (w : S ⟶ X),
   164	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v =
   165	      g.app (op S) w →
   166	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (F.W : Scheme.{u}),
   167	      F.fst.app (op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ F.W.ι = w
   168	
   169	lemma fst_comp_incl (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   170	    F.fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
   171	  apply yonedaEquiv.injective
   172	  change (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) F.locusValue =
   173	    (yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g).app (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) (𝟙 (F.W : Scheme.{u}))
   174	  dsimp [locusValue, picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   175	    CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat]
   176	  rw [← F.restrictedValue_eq]
   177	
   178	/-- The family evaluation divisor has the displayed family as its Abel class. -/
   179	lemma evaluationDivisor_abel
   180	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   181	    F.evaluationDivisor ≫ rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi =
   182	      yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
   183	  rw [evaluationDivisor, Category.assoc, E.divisor_toAmbient]
   184	  exact F.fst_comp_incl
   185	
   186	/-! ## The represented evaluation-divisor square -/
   187	
   188	/-- The canonical evaluation divisor represents the pullback of Abel along the displayed
   189	family.  This is stronger than the factorisation clause for the public rank-one locus: it is a
   190	categorical pullback against the entire represented genus-divisor functor. -/
   191	def EvaluationDivisorPullback
   192	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
   193	  IsPullback
   194	    F.evaluationDivisor
   195	    (yoneda.map F.W.ι)
   196	    (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi)
   197	    g
   198	
   199	/-- The represented evaluation-divisor square produces the public-locus factorisation on every
   200	test scheme. -/
   201	lemma fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
   202	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   203	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   204	    F.FibreFactorizationClause := by
   205	  intro S v w hvw
   206	  have hS := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op S)
   207	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hS
   208	  have hcompat :
   209	      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
   210	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
   211	        g.app (op S) w := by
   212	    have h := congrArg
   213	      (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_toAmbient
   214	    change
   215	      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
   216	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
   217	        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v at h
   218	    rw [h]
   219	    exact hvw
   220	  obtain ⟨u, _huDivisor, huW⟩ :=
   221	    hS.2.2 (E.divisor.app (op S) v) w hcompat
   222	  change u ≫ F.W.ι = w at huW
   223	  refine ⟨u, ?_, huW⟩
   224	  apply picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl_app_injective pi S
   225	  have hsquare := congrArg
   226	    (fun q => q.app (op S) u) F.fst_comp_incl
   227	  change
   228	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u) =
   229	      g.app (op S) (u ≫ F.W.ι) at hsquare
   230	  calc
   231	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u) =
   232	        g.app (op S) (u ≫ F.W.ι) := hsquare
   233	    _ = g.app (op S) w := congrArg _ huW
   234	    _ = (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v := hvw.symm
   235	
   236	/-! ## Assembly of the stronger fibre datum -/
   237	
   238	/-- Assemble the public fibre presentation from the represented canonical evaluation-divisor
   239	square.  Its `exists_factor` field is derived from the pullback universal property. -/
   240	noncomputable def toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
   241	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   242	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   243	    PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g where
   244	  W := F.W
   245	  fst := F.fst
   246	  sq := F.fst_comp_incl
   247	  exists_factor := by
   248	    simpa only [FibreFactorizationClause] using
   249	      F.fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback hpb
   250	
   251	@[simp]
   252	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_W
   253	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   254	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   255	    (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback hpb).W = F.W :=
   256	  rfl

   259	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   260	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   261	    IsPullback F.fst (yoneda.map F.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g :=
   262	  (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback hpb).isPullback
   263

   265	
   266	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_evaluationDivisorPullbackFamilies
   267	    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)

   269	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),

   271	    (hpb : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   272	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
   273	      (D X g).EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   274	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
   275	  apply picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented pi
   276	  intro X g
   277	  exact (D X g).toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback (hpb X g)

The factor proof can use the divisor leg itself, not merely the base lift: the evaluator’s Abel section law makes it pointwise injective. I’m rewriting the proof to recover `fst u = v` from the pullback’s divisor equality, which removes the old Sigma-inclusion injectivity detour and makes the canonical evaluation family essential to the construction.
